council_map.notes: Saved as raw/noblesville-in/districts-map.pdf; read as an image, it matches the council page names/districts. Live page https://www.noblesville.in.gov/ is behind a Cloudflare check for curl, so Wayback copies were used. Likely GIS lead: https://gis1.hamiltoncounty.in.gov/ArcGIS/rest/services/HamCoPolitical/MapServer/7 ('Municipal Council Districts', named in a search result). INACCESSIBLE: the host resets the connection (TLS) for curl and node, so count/fields not checked and it is not known whether it holds Noblesville.

notes: Council page snapshot is April 2025 (latest usable); the current 2023-elected council would still sit through 2027 unless someone was replaced; not confirmed after April 2025. The live noblesville.in.gov/mayor and /council pages could not be saved (Cloudflare bot check); Wayback copy of /mayor (Jan 2026) returned a not-found style page without names. Clerk page says the Clerk also serves as statutory Clerk of the Noblesville City Court, so a city court exists; the judge is not named here. Noblesville is a second-class city (6+3, City Clerk plus appointed controller).
